svg.title: L3 four sub-systems collaboration loop
svg.desc: Drive state from L2 enters reasoning core alongside retrieved memories and anchor domain. Reasoning core produces scored candidates. Basal ganglia selects and releases via default inhibition, using RPE to learn over time and eventually crystallizing skills into the skill library. Released action goes through mediator to tool edge. Outcome feeds back as RPE to basal ganglia and as new episodic memory.
svg.text: outcome → RPE back to BG · new event → episodic memory
